name: host-manager
title: Hosts 管家
author: triple3h
description: 按块管理 hosts：一个项目一个块、块级开关、外部条目单独成块；只替换自己的托管区，别的程序写的行一律不碰，写入前备份

commands.name: hosts
commands.title: Hosts 管家
commands.placeholder: 搜索域名，或粘贴「1.2.3.4 example.com」直接添加

commands.name: hosts-read
commands.title: 读取 Hosts 文件（脚本）

commands.name: hosts-write
commands.title: 写入 Hosts 文件（脚本）

scripts.build: vue-tsc --noEmit -p tsconfig.json && vite build && node scripts/build-no-view.mjs
scripts.test: node ../../scripts/run-ts.mjs test/core.test.ts && node ../../scripts/run-ts.mjs test/blocks.test.ts && node ../../scripts/run-ts.mjs test/script.test.ts
